status_definitions.derived_in_chapter: A derivation is explicit in the canonical chapter and has an author mathematical audit; independent acceptance is recorded separately against file hashes.
status_definitions.external_theorem_statement_checked: The cited theorem statement, displayed identity and relevant hypotheses were inspected in primary material; a complete independent proof of the external theorem is not asserted.
status_definitions.conditional_quantum_consequence: A consequence of the explicit phase, amplitude, cycle, nondegeneracy and global-dominance assumptions; those assumptions are not established by finite coefficient checks.
status_definitions.external_conjecture: Retained as a conjecture for the stated class, with a separately cited theorem for the specified figure-eight fillings.
status_definitions.illustration: A schematic drawing of the equations, not computational or geometric evidence.
